heading.en: A return to Torrey without improvisation

en: Reach Panorama Point before sunset, remain on the established surface and return toward Torrey on the same paved road. Arrive while signs, edges and the walking surface remain visible. Mark the vehicle, the safe observation footprint and the simplest retreat before opening equipment. A useful session can be short. Dark adaptation and patient naked-eye orientation often reveal more than hurried setup followed by a second drive.

Keep orchards, campsites and historic structures free of stray light and avoid blocking pull-outs. Pack in a fixed order, count every small item and leave while concentration is still good. If storm cells or road alerts appear, stay in Torrey and do not search for an improvised position in the Fold. That fallback is part of the route rather than a consolation prize. It protects the destination, the people sharing it and the credibility of a guide that must work beyond a perfect-weather photograph.
